Energy & Inputs.title: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (HIGH) $85 in August?
Energy & Inputs.why_it_matters: Market pricing 74% odds crude will reach $85. Closes in 19d. Would lift farm diesel and pass through to nitrogen fertilizer cost within a few months.

Energy & Inputs.title: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (LOW) $60 in August?
